units.source_text: 植村正要回话，龙助就站了起来。

en.t: Just as Uemura was about to answer, Ryusuke stood up.

units.source_text: 他哭丧着脸，望着朝千重子和真一所在的内客厅走去的龙助的背影。

en.t: With a grief-stricken look on his face, he watched Ryusuke from behind as he walked toward the inner parlor where Chieko and Shinichi were.

units.source_text: 掌柜明白，说要看账簿的千重子和眼前的龙助之间，暗地里定有某种联系。

en.t: The head clerk understood that there must be some hidden connection between Chieko, who had said she wanted to see the account books, and Ryusuke standing before him.
